name: Cheeseguy Pixel
description: Pixel-art character style derived from a reference sheet.
positive: Detailed Ragnarok-like pixel-art chibi, roughly four to five heads tall, long legs and a readable torso rather than a giant head. Dark near-black outline around the silhouette and interior line work. Four or five soft pixel shading bands per material (skin, hair, cloth, metal, leather), with highlight and shadow clusters rather than flat fills. Muted, slightly desaturated base colours with a few strong accents. Hair in strands and chunky locks, armor/accessories with readable plates and trim, feet planted at the bottom of the canvas. Crisp one-pixel details, no anti-aliasing.
negative: no flat single-colour fills, no missing or light outline, no one-to-one super-deformed head/body ratio, no pure black, no soft anti-aliased edges, no high-saturation candy palette, no generic blank face, no chunky 32px proportions.
